title: Freestanding Coat Rack With Eight Pivoting Pegs - 60-Inch Solid Brass, Weighted Base, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bath robes, towels, and everyday layers organized without drilling into your walls—this freestanding coat rack is backed by a lifetime warranty and adds traditional style to any bathroom.

  • Create an instant drop zone for robes, coats, and hats with eight pivoting pegs
  • Place it anywhere—freestanding design requires no wall mounting
  • Enjoy a steadier, safer setup with a weighted base that helps prevent tipping
  • Protect tile, wood, or vinyl floors with a felt pad that helps prevent scratches
  • Choose a look that fits your space with a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Why it lasts: Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives for daily bathroom use.

Specs

  • Product type: Freestanding coat rack with eight pivoting pegs
  • Mounting: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in
  • Weight capacity: 18 lb
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Included items: Freestanding coat rack
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to coordinate your traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
